customManagers.description: Watch crates.io for the next `virt` release. lodger carries a `# renovate:` annotation plus a `virt-crates-io-release-watch = "<ver>"` comment line next to the Git pin in Cargo.toml. A bump PR here means upstream published a release, so the Git pin can move back to crates.io once the release contains the reviewed commit. Held for review (`vendored` label) by the watcher rule below: the PR is a signal to act on, so it must not auto-merge.

Track the pinned actionlint release in actionlint.yml via github-releases, copied from the scratchsmith preset. Renovate bumps ONLY ACTIONLINT_VERSION; the postUpgradeTask rule below refreshes the adjacent ACTIONLINT_SHA256 in the same commit. If the task cannot run, the job's own `sha256sum -c` fails loudly.

packageRules.description: Hold the MSRV job's Rust toolchain at the DECLARED minimum (Cargo.toml rust-version = 1.95). ci.yml's `build (MSRV 1.95)` job exists to prove the workspace still builds on that floor; tracking it toward stable would silently stop verifying the MSRV. Bump it only with a deliberate rust-version raise. Same rule as scratchsmith.

Hold the `virt` crate's Git pin for review. lodger pins libvirt-rust master by full commit; the cargo manager extracts that `rev =` pin and proposes new master commits as DIGEST updates, which the shared base would auto-merge. Every bump needs the written diff review in lodger's docs/virt-pin.md, so it waits in the queue with the `vendored` label like a custom-manager bump.

Hold the `virt` crates.io release watcher (the custom manager above). Its PR only moves the watch comment in Cargo.toml; auto-merging it would erase the signal that the Git pin can move back to crates.io.

Hold Rust toolchain bumps in rust-toolchain.toml (native rust-toolchain manager) for review. lodger pins an exact release instead of `stable`, so moving the toolchain is a deliberate PR: new clippy lints and MSRV-sensitive changes get a human look before merge.

Supply-chain cooldown, copied from scratchsmith: soak every update for 7 days before it may merge (auto-merges included). lodger holds root-equivalent libvirt access on its host, so a freshly published or yanked release must not land the same day. Security fixes stay immediate via the shared default's vulnerabilityAlerts (minimumReleaseAge: null).
Digests and pins carry no release date, so the release-age soak can never pass and Renovate would suppress or never merge them. Exempt them from the soak.

Hold TypeScript below 7 for lodger's web app. SvelteKit 2.70 supports TypeScript up to 6, so a TypeScript 7 PR would only break `svelte-check` and the build. Remove this rule once SvelteKit's peer range includes TypeScript 7.

Move vitest and its @vitest/* plugins in ONE PR. @vitest/coverage-v8 must match vitest's version exactly, so a PR that bumps only one of them breaks `pnpm run test:coverage`. The group applies to every update type, majors included; majors still wait for review under the shared base.

Refresh the actionlint sha256 in-branch on a version bump: scripts/check_binary_dep_pins.py --fix rewrites ACTIONLINT_SHA256 in actionlint.yml from GitHub's published asset digest (ported from clauster). Auto-merges on green CI under the base policy: actionlint runs only in CI. The command must be on RENOVATE_ALLOWED_POST_UPGRADE_COMMANDS.
